author: Wintergatan
description:
MARBLE MACHINE DESIGN CHALLENGE

Make the ultimate Snap-In Programming profile for the Marble Machine!
Send your Design ideas as Onshape links here:
https://forms.gle/SzoCR1bzwDiLcxkaA

Try Onshape Free - Engineers Get Up to 6 Months Pro with the Wintergatan Link:
https://onshape.pro/Wintergatan

DESIGN REQUIREMENTS:
•⁠  ⁠Curved Stainless steel sheet metal base, 1mm thin, 1600mm diameter bend
•⁠  ⁠Holes are laser or watercut in the curved base

•⁠  ⁠Profiles Max Width 9mm
•⁠  ⁠Profiles Max Height above base 40mm
•⁠  ⁠Profiles lengths varies from 80mm-200mm
•⁠  ⁠3D Printed, design for printability

•⁠  ⁠Snaps in and out from the top surface (no fastening from the undersideof the base)
•⁠  ⁠Must stay perpendicular to base within +-1mm of top of profile
•⁠  ⁠Top reading surface can have different heights (20/30/40mm) within the same profile
•⁠  ⁠Center-center distance 10mm between programming channels
•⁠  ⁠Lengthwise position tolerance +- 0.4mm
•⁠  ⁠Heightwise position tolerance +-1mm

•
